title: Promotion manifest (per-project)
description: Written at PROMOTION_QUEUE (distribution/promotion-manifest.json) and updated at PROMOTION_PUBLISHED. The audit of promotional posts: one queued post per platform with distinct message text (anti-spam guardrail), a human review at PROMOTION_REVIEW, then automatable platforms fire via net/publish.* while manual platforms become checklist items. Records status + outcome per post.

video_url.description: Canonical watch URL (e.g. the YouTube upload) the posts point at, if known.

message.description: Platform-specific post text; must differ across platforms (no identical cross-posting).
